snippet.title: Rich & Rox On Autism, ADHD and Finally Unmasking

ADHD Love are a neurodivergent married couple and global internet phenomenon with millions of followers online.  But this is a side of Rich and Rox you’ve never seen before.

In one of their most honest conversations yet, they open up about the reality of navigating ADHD, autism, masking, intimacy, alcohol, marriage, and the challenges that come with being a neurodivergent couple.

snippet.title: Being Gaslit? Here's What to Do
snippet.description:
Are you constantly questioning your own reality? If you feel confused after conversations or like someone is "messing with your head," you are likely experiencing gaslighting. In this essential follow-up, UKCP-accredited Psychotherapist Ahi Wheeler shares practical, clinical strategies to protect your mental health and shut down emotional manipulation.

With over 20 years of experience in the NHS and private practice, Ahi moves beyond "advice" to provide a roadmap for maintaining your internal equilibrium in toxic environments.

⚠️ SAFETY CAVEAT: These strategies are for emotional manipulation only. If there is a risk of physical abuse, please seek external intervention immediately.

🕒 In this video:
0:00 – Intro: What is Gaslighting & Emotional Manipulation?
0:27 – IMPORTANT: Safety Warning & Physical Abuse
0:53 – Strategy 1: Information as Protection (Spotting Tactics)
1:44 – The 3 Strikes Rule: Identifying a Pattern of Abuse
2:00 – Strategy 2: Keeping Records & Documentation (Work vs. Personal)
2:35 – The Power of Bullet Point Emails & Record Keeping
3:20 – Maintaining Internal Integrity: Staying Connected to Self
4:38 – Strategy 3: The "Broken Record" Technique
5:40 – The "Gray Rock" Method: How to become unremarkable
6:13 – Conclusion: Why Disengaging is the Ultimate Solution

About Ahi Wheeler:
Ahi is a senior psychotherapist and mental health specialist with two decades of experience. Her work is informed by psychodynamic and integrative techniques, as well as a deep interest in philosophy and literature. She works with individuals and couples to break unconscious patterns and reclaim their sense of self.

Book a session with Ahi: 🔗 https://www.harleytherapy.co.uk/ahi-wheeler.htm

snippet.title: Why Self-Care is Easy to Drop and What to do About It #ADHD #selfcare #lifehack
snippet.description:
When we're super busy things that don't have immediate impact are often the first things we begin to ignore. This is true for a lot of people, but for those of us with ADHD, it can tend to happen A LOT. And, unfortunately, ignoring self-care doesn't tend to have an immediate impact. 

This is why adding immediate impact can be such a great tool in helping us do those self-care tasks that are important for our survival, our sanity, our relaxation. One of my favourite examples? snippet.title: Misdiagnosed? Why Trauma Looks Like ADHD & Autism
snippet.description:
Is it ADHD, or is your nervous system stuck in a survival response?

With the rise in neurodivergence awareness, many are questioning if their struggles with focus, procrastination, and "fitting in" are due to their neurotype or a history of trauma. The symptoms of ADHD and Autism often mirror the body’s response to Complex Trauma (C-PTSD).

In this video, systemic therapist Stefan Walters explores the "shocking fact" that many ADHD diagnoses may actually be trauma-related. Stefan utilises the Polyvagal framework—a widely recognised clinical model—to help map out the nervous system's response to stress and safety. Learn how a "bottom-up" approach to therapy can help you differentiate between your intrinsic personality and a dysregulated nervous system.

Key Chapters
0:00 – Are you questioning an ADHD or Autism diagnosis?
1:25 – When symptoms are actually nervous system dysregulation
2:48 – The overlap between Trauma and ADHD (Hyperfocus & Procrastination)
3:55 – Top-Down vs. Bottom-Up therapy: Getting to the root cause
4:58 – Misdiagnosing Autism: The "Dorsal Vagal Collapse" vs. Neurotype
5:57 – The Priority-Focused vs. Interest-Focused nervous system
6:49 – Mapping the Nervous System: The Polyvagal Framework
9:15 – Why "Depression" might actually be "Deep Rest"
9:35 – Misdiagnosing Personality Disorders (BPD, NPD, Bipolar)
10:39 – 5 Tips to regulate your Vagus Nerve at home
12:31 – Transformation: How Brainspotting helps discharge trauma

About Stefan Walters
Stefan Walters (MSc, BSc, AFT, BPS) is a specialist in Couples Counselling, ADHD coaching, and Trauma. Trained at San Diego State University and a specialist in Brainspotting, he works with the subcortical brain to create deep, lasting change. Stefan is a known expert featured in The Guardian, the BBC, and the Huffington Post.
